;; (PNH. EQ.1: CL uses ETA(1) with no IOV term added -- the app has no IOV ;; component in the PNH prior either, M.priorOmega('PNH','eculizumab') is ;; the plain 2-dim [0.1546, 0.0812]). The IOV/OCC machinery of the original ;; file is dropped entirely: it is inert for PNH subjects there too (only ;; the PNH.EQ.0 branch ever references IOV), so nothing is lost. ;; Estimation-engine validation -- eculizumab, PNH. ;; Adapted from ../../nonmemcontrolstream.txt for POSTHOC individual ;; estimation with population parameters FIXED at their published values. ;; Structural ($PK/$DES) code is verbatim from the original PNH branch $PROBLEM Estimation-engine validation -- eculizumab PNH POSTHOC $INPUT ID TIME AMT RATE DV MDV EVID CMT CENS WT AGE $DATA ecu_pnh.csv IGNORE=@ $SUBROUTINE ADVAN13 TOL=9 $MODEL COMP=(CENTRAL) COMP=(PERIPHERAL) $PK CL = THETA(1) * ((WT/70)**0.75) * EXP(ETA(1)) V1 = THETA(2) * (WT/70) * EXP(ETA(2)) V2 = THETA(5) * (WT/70) Q = THETA(6) * ((WT/70)**0.75) VM = THETA(3) * ((WT/70)**0.75) KM = THETA(4) S1 = V1 KEL = CL/V1 K12 = Q/V1 K21 = Q/V2
$DES C1 = A(1)/S1 DADT(1) = -KEL*A(1) - ((VM*C1)/(KM+C1)) - K12*A(1) + K21*A(2) DADT(2) = -K21*A(2) + K12*A(1)
;; With the LIKE (user-supplied likelihood) option NONMEM forbids a $SIGMA ;; record entirely -- the residual-variance constants are carried as two ;; extra FIXED THETAs instead (7, 8) and used explicitly below, matching ;; src/bayes.js's own `v = sig.ADD + sig.PROP*pred*pred` formula exactly. ;; NONMEM's LIKE option expects Y to be the LIKELIHOOD itself (a positive ;; density/probability), not its log -- NONMEM applies -2*LOG(Y) internally. $ERROR IPRED = F SD = SQRT(THETA(7) + THETA(8)*IPRED*IPRED) IF (CENS.EQ.0) THEN Y = (1/SQRT(6.283185307179586*SD*SD)) * EXP(-0.5*((DV-IPRED)/SD)**2) ELSE Y = PHI((DV-IPRED)/SD) ; DV carries the LLOQ on a censored row ENDIF
$THETA 0.1626 FIX ; 1 CL L/day 4.299 FIX ; 2 V1 L 25.64 FIX ; 3 VM mg/day 13.54 FIX ; 4 KM mg/L 2.63 FIX ; 5 V2 L 0.6243 FIX ; 6 Q L/day 19.1 FIX ; 7 SIGMA additive variance 0.0185 FIX ; 8 SIGMA proportional variance $OMEGA 0.1546 FIX ; 1 IIV CL (PNH: no IOV folded in) 0.0812 FIX ; 2 IIV V1 $ESTIMATION METHOD=1 LAPLACE LIKE NOABORT MAXEVAL=0 PRINT=1 POSTHOC
